subject.title: [Feishu] 飞书群多机器人身份混乱问题

question: Which stable Feishu bot/account discriminator should become part of durable group session identity, and how should existing Feishu group session history be migrated or repaired?
rationale: The fix crosses durable session-key, message-routing, and bot/account authorization boundaries; automation can identify the missing discriminator but cannot safely choose the compatibility and security tradeoff.

options.title: Account-Scoped Group Sessions
options.body: Include the normalized OpenClaw Feishu account boundary in group session identity and provide doctor or migration handling for existing group keys.

options.title: Platform App Identity Scope
options.body: Use a Feishu platform identity such as appId or a proven bot identity if maintainers prefer platform semantics over OpenClaw account ids.

options.title: Defer To Broader Feishu Identity Design
options.body: Keep this issue open while adjacent mention, context, and DM identity work converge on one shared Feishu identity model.

recommendation.title: Account-Scoped Group Sessions
recommendation.body: Include the normalized OpenClaw Feishu account boundary in group session identity and provide doctor or migration handling for existing group keys.

likelyOwner.reason: They have recent Feishu identity/routing review context and current Feishu contributions near the affected code path.
